oneLine: Maharashtra Oil Extractions files draft IPO papers with SEBI to raise Rs 370 crore.

sources.title: Maharashtra Oil Extractions files draft IPO papers with SEBI to raise Rs 370 crore

synopsis: Soya bean products maker Maharashtra Oil Extractions has filed draft papers with SEBI for an initial public offering. The IPO comprises a fresh issue of shares worth Rs 370 crore and an offer-for-sale of 2.14 crore equity shares by its promoters. The company may also consider raising up to Rs 25 crore in a pre-IPO round, which would reduce the fresh issue component accordingly. Net proceeds will be utilized for capital expenditure at its Dhule manufacturing facility, upgrading facilities at Nandurbar and Gangakhed, working capital requirements, and general corporate purposes. IDBI Capital Markets & Securities, Dolat Finserv, and Elara Capital (India) have been appointed as merchant bankers for the issue.
